knownFacts: Failure arose during actual Service run shutdown, after fresh credential approval was observed.
Current process observation no longer finds pid24956; this later observation cannot prove its state at failure.
The existing EPERM exception requires synchronous try_wait(Some) before empty-group verification.
The error does not report which of try_wait(None) or nonempty group caused refusal, so original exact branch remains unknown.

nativeObservation.result: All3: killpg EPERM, waitpid WNOHANG=0, getpgid=-1/ESRCH, sysctl group648bytes; subsequent exact waitpid reaped every own child.
nativeObservation.scopeLimit: Demonstrates a real macOS exiting/reapability window; does not assert that this exclusively explains pid24956.

minimumFixProposal: On macOS EPERM in async stop, retain the original own pid before any try_wait mutation.
Use the existing two-second cleanup budget to actually await the owned child exit, then verify the process group is empty with the existing sysctl guard.
Never treat getpgid=-1 alone as success, never suppress live-group EPERM, never signal a group after the owned child has been reaped.
Preserve synchronous Drop honesty; it cannot block on async wait or claim confirmed cleanup.
minimumRustRegressionPlan: Bounded real self-owned child natural-exit tests call the real McpChild.stop; retain actual errno/try_wait/group observations.
A still-live self-owned group must remain nonempty until real kill/wait, so the empty-group exception cannot swallow live cleanup failure.
Do not replace kernel calls, storage, process identity, or clock.
